recipes.title: Avocado Salad
recipes.ingredients: 2 ripe avocados, 1 cup cherry tomatoes, 1 cucumber, 1/4 red onion, cilantro, olive oil, lime juice.
recipes.instructions: Mix all diced vegetables in a bowl, drizzle with olive oil and lime juice, and toss gently.

recipes.title: Pancakes
recipes.instructions: Mix all ingredients. Fry for 2 minutes each side.

recipes.title: Healthy Burgers
recipes.ingredients: Black beans, oats, onion, garlic, spices, whole grain buns.
recipes.instructions: Mash beans, mix with ingredients, form patties and grill until firm.

recipes.title: Healthy Chicken Breast and Broccoli
recipes.ingredients: Chicken breast, broccoli, soy sauce, ginger, garlic.
recipes.instructions: Stir-fry chicken until golden, add broccoli and sauce, cook until tender.

recipes.title: Berry Oatmeal Bowl
recipes.ingredients: Rolled oats, almond milk, blueberries, strawberries, chia seeds, honey.
recipes.instructions: Cook oats with milk, top with fresh berries and seeds. Drizzle with honey.

recipes.title: Grilled Salmon & Asparagus
recipes.ingredients: Salmon fillet, asparagus, lemon, olive oil, garlic, black pepper.
recipes.instructions: Season salmon and asparagus. Grill for 10-12 minutes. Serve with lemon slices.

recipes.title: Quinoa Buddha Bowl
recipes.ingredients: Quinoa, chickpeas, spinach, roasted sweet potato, tahini dressing.
recipes.instructions: Place quinoa in a bowl, arrange veggies on top, and pour over the tahini sauce.

recipes.title: Greek Yogurt Parfait
recipes.ingredients: Greek yogurt, granola, walnuts, pomegranate seeds, mint leaves.
recipes.instructions: Layer yogurt and granola in a glass. Top with walnuts and pomegranate.

recipes.title: Eggplant Shakshuka
recipes.ingredients: Eggs, tomato sauce, eggplant, bell peppers, feta cheese, parsley.
recipes.instructions: Simmer veggies in tomato sauce, crack eggs on top, cover until eggs are set.
